remarks:
Opportunity awaits at 232 Main Street, East Randolph, NY! This 1,470-square-foot Cape Cod-style home sits on a manageable 58' x 95' lot and offers a blank canvas for your vision. The home has been completely gutted, providing the perfect opportunity to design and finish the interior to suit your personal style, needs, or investment goals.

Enjoy the convenience of village living with public water, sewer, natural gas, and electric already connected to the property. The classic Cape Cod design offers the potential for additional living space on the second floor, creating flexibility for extra bedrooms, a home office, or recreational space.

Located just minutes from Randolph Central School, local shopping, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, this property combines small-town charm with accessibility. Easy access to Interstate 86 makes commuting simple while providing convenient travel to nearby destinations including Jamestown, Salamanca, Ellicottville, Allegany State Park, Seneca Allegany Resort & Casino, and the recreational opportunities of Chautauqua County and the Enchanted Mountains region.

Whether you're looking to create your dream home, a rental property, or a renovation project, this property offers endless possibilities. Conveniently located in "East" Randolph, you'll appreciate the accessibility to local amenities while enjoying the charm of a small-town community. Bring your imagination and turn this property into something special!

No children at showings as there are missing floor boards and no handrailing.
